title: Recipe scaler
description: A pixel recipe scaler: a built-in recipe of 5 ingredients with amounts for 4 servings, a servings input from 1 to 12, and the amounts rescaled live, rounded to one decimal.

title: Binary converter
description: A pixel number converter: type a decimal number from 0 to 255 and see it in binary (8 digits), hexadecimal and as 8 toggleable bit lamps; clicking a lamp updates the number.

title: Mini kanban
description: A pixel kanban board with To do, Doing and Done columns: add a card to To do, move a card left or right with arrow buttons, show a count per column and delete cards.

title: Breathing guide
description: A pixel breathing guide: a circle that grows during a 4-second inhale and shrinks during a 4-second exhale, a label saying Inhale or Exhale, Start and Stop buttons and a cycle counter.

title: Seat picker
description: A pixel cinema seat picker: 5 rows of 8 seats, some seats already taken, click free seats to select or deselect them, show the selected seats like 'B4, B5' and the total price at 9 per seat.

title: Morse translator
description: A pixel Morse code translator: type text and see it in Morse code with letters separated by spaces and words by slashes, and a second box that translates Morse back to text.

title: Clicker game
description: A pixel clicker game: click a big coin to earn points, buy an Auto-clicker upgrade for 10 points that adds 1 point per second, show points, the upgrade count and its next price which doubles each time.

title: Quick poll
description: A pixel poll: a question with 4 options, vote by clicking an option, show the vote count and percentage bar for each option, allow changing your vote, and a Reset votes button.
